items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: If he knew you were coming there, he already came with you.

ctx.x: Oh, that's right. You see you at the wake. About two or three weeks ago? Yeah, on Blandin's. At Blandin's. Yeah, it was Easter Saturday. I mean Good Friday.
Good Friday. Right over there at Sheik. We just saw Sheik walking over there by the corner here a minute ago.
Yeah. If he knew you were coming there, he already came with you.
